section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS), a 13-item instrument developed by Avalos et al. (2005) to measure positive body image. The scale uses a 5-point rating format (1=never to 5=always), with Item 12 being sex-specific to account for different media representations (thin images for women, muscular images for men). The English version demonstrated unidimensional structure for women, test-retest reliability, and good construct, discriminant, and incremental validities.

section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS), a 13-item instrument designed to measure positive body image across four dimensions. The scale uses a 5-point rating system (1=never to 5=always), with Item 12 being sex-specific to address gender-relevant media influences (thin images for women, muscular images for men). Table 1 presents all 13 BAS items and their factor loadings separately for women and men from an exploratory factor analysis, demonstrating the scale's structure and gender differences in item loadings.
